verification.command: python eng/contracts.py pack; python -m unittest discover -s tests/tooling -v
verification.expected: Pinned Dokka 2.2.0 output admits the exact r14 member/page set. CON.09 adds 5210 contracts-proto API pages and 55 contracts-connect-client API pages; the optional proto3 presence repair adds exactly eight TransferTicket has-url/has-max-part-bytes pages. Only the 24 affected contracts-proto hashes (TransferTicket API, package-list and page index) and three corresponding Kotlin producer input hashes are refreshed; the connect-client and contract-fixtures page/input bytes remain unchanged. The class page binds hasUrl and hasMaxPartBytes; all other 86 message schemas, six owned Connect clients, 42 fixed and 10 excluded resource bytes, font transform, upstream source identity, package identities, and Apache/MIT component closure remain unchanged.

notice.text: Dokka 2.2.0 API documentation includes its Apache-2.0 frontend and the reviewed Apache/MIT dependency closure. Every documentation companion retains all 81 dependency licence texts and the Dokka licence/NOTICE. The ten embedded OFL fonts and their four font-face declarations are excluded; system font fallbacks remain. No JDK Javadoc GPL resource is used. Public API documentation, navigation and offline search remain available. An Apache-2.0 ArcForges CSS correction makes content links readable in the dark theme.
notice.reason: The documentation distributes these upstream resources. Runtime client archives do not contain the Dokka frontend.
